Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (enterprise partner GTM) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s partnership architecture function sits where frontier-model capabilities meet enterprise delivery reality.
The core challenge is converting partner access to Claude into governed, repeatable customer outcomes across
complex organizations.

This requires balancing expansion with consistency. As external delivery organizations bring Claude into more
accounts, technical quality, security expectations, adoption practices, and field learning must remain coherent
rather than varying materially by partner or region.

The role is likely consequential because it connects ecosystem scale with the practical details that determine
whether customers realize value after evaluation: implementation design, workflow adoption, controls, and
operational readiness.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a frontier AI company centered on Claude and structured as a public benefit corporation. Its stated
identity emphasizes dependable AI behavior, interpretability, steerability, and responsible development.

Its market presence spans business teams, developers, and enterprise technology organizations. Claude is
positioned for knowledge work, analysis, software work, and complex problem solving, creating a product surface
that can enter an organization through multiple technical and business pathways.

This creates a commercial model in which product capability alone is insufficient. Enterprise value depends on
how customers connect tools to workflows, establish appropriate controls, prepare users, and expand successful
patterns without losing confidence in the technology.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic must support several routes into an enterprise at once: broad employee usage, developer integration,
and software-focused workflows. These routes may involve distinct sponsors, budgets, control requirements,
implementation teams, and measures of success.

Enterprise adoption guidance frames deployment as an ongoing operating journey. Technical setup is paired with
launch planning, organizational change, education, and broader usage expansion. That framing makes the quality
of customer delivery a strategic issue rather than a downstream services concern.

For the ecosystem, the pressure is to make partners capable of delivering credible outcomes at scale while
keeping customer feedback useful. Raw field anecdotes are less valuable than structured evidence about recurring
requirements, integration friction, governance needs, and observed adoption barriers.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Partner architecture operates across a broad set of internal and external decision makers. Success likely depends
on establishing shared technical standards without creating unnecessary friction for commercial teams or partners.

- Cloud, technology, and services firms need clear paths from product familiarity to delivery capability.

Anthropic’s January 2026 introduction of Labs, associated in research with Mike Krieger, signals continuing
organizational evolution around product innovation. That environment increases the value of teams that can
translate changing capabilities into clear partner-facing practices.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is presented as an AI assistant designed around safety, accuracy, and security, with support for analysis,
writing, coding, and difficult business problems. In that context, architecture is part of the value proposition:
customers need confidence not only in model performance, but also in how capabilities fit their environment.

Claude Enterprise includes security, compliance, and administration features for both business and developer
audiences. Administrator materials also address Claude Code seat configuration, indicating that governance may
need to span general employee use and technical-builder use within the same organization.

The resulting architecture agenda is broader than API connectivity. It includes controlled access, role design,
implementation sequencing, workflow integration, enablement, measurement, and expansion planning. Reusable
patterns must be technically credible for enterprise IT while remaining understandable to sponsors and delivery
teams.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes cloud, technology, and services partners as important routes for addressing customer AI
challenges. This suggests an ecosystem model built around joint customer outcomes rather than simple lead sharing.

Each partner type brings a distinct scaling mechanism. Cloud providers can influence infrastructure and
procurement paths; technology firms can embed Claude within adjacent product contexts; services organizations
can provide implementation capacity, industry knowledge, and organizational-change support.

The critical operating unit is likely the reusable joint offering: a defined customer problem, reference design,
delivery approach, governance model, enablement package, and path from initial interest to sustained use.

- Partner education must create practical delivery competence, not only product familiarity or sales awareness.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s Labs introduction in January 2026 indicates continued movement in its product and innovation
organization. Meanwhile, its enterprise materials emphasize adoption beyond initial technical activation.

Together, these signals create urgency for a strong partner architecture capability. Product evolution may move
faster than partner practices, while large customers expect external advisors to translate new functionality into
secure, understandable, and operationally viable deployments.

Competitive conditions in enterprise AI heighten this need. Differentiation is experienced through customer
implementation: whether teams can use the product effectively, whether governance is workable, and whether
partners can turn technical promise into sustained business value.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Designing enablement systems for cloud, consulting, and technology ecosystems.
- Converting customer problems into reusable solution patterns, reference designs, and rollout playbooks.
- Connecting enterprise architecture, governance, security, and organizational adoption.
- Establishing evidence-based feedback mechanisms between field delivery and product development.
- Leading across partnerships, commercial teams, engineering, product, and customer technology organizations.
- Creating operating discipline for indirect growth in fast-changing technical environments.
- Combining technical depth with executive communication, coaching, and ecosystem influence.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic frames enterprise success as sustained adoption rather than a one-time implementation milestone.
- The ecosystem opportunity is to make Claude delivery more repeatable across varied customer environments.
- Cloud, services, and technology partners require different forms of technical readiness and operating support.
- Enterprise usage spans business teams and developers, increasing the importance of coordinated governance.
- Joint offerings can package partner expertise into credible, reusable routes to customer value.
- Structured learning from delivery teams can help separate broad product needs from isolated account requests.
- Anthropic’s responsible-AI identity makes deployment quality a commercial and reputational consideration.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, scope, leadership, technical depth,
and partnership results must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
